safety.existingGpxRetention: Preserve all existing stored tracks, filenames, derived profiles and user edits. Rights enforcement never deletes or rewrites them.
safety.restrictionBehavior: Block organizer-course GPX fetch, import, processing, storage, map display and user download unless each required action has explicit route-specific permission and restriction status is clear.
safety.linkBehavior: An official information/GPX page link requires its own explicit gpxOfficialLink permission. A direct .gpx URL requires explicit gpxFileUserDownload permission; link permission never authorizes file retrieval.
safety.userMessageRestricted: GPX durch Veranstalter eingeschränkt – kein Download möglich
safety.userMessagePending: GPX gesperrt – keine ausdrückliche Freigabe dokumentiert; kein Download möglich
